reviews.body: Blocking on idempotency, rest looks good.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: This moves money, so it needs `@idempotent` (ADR-004). Without it a mobile retry after a timeout creates a second payout, the same way we double-refunded in January.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Argh, I even reviewed the ADR. Added, plus a test for the replay path.

comments.author: frank
comments.body: These test functions and the fixtures should have type annotations. mypy strict everywhere or it's not strict.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: We deliberately don't type tests. mypy excludes tests/ in pyproject, and fixture types add a lot of noise for no real safety. Leaving as is.

threads.rejection_reason: We don't type tests; mypy excludes tests/ on purpose.
